frame: CIG/CryEngine. X lateral, Y fore/aft, Z up. METRES.
hull_rule: the .cga whose basename equals its folder name. Exact, case-insensitive. No fuzzy matching.
not_converted: Viewer frame is y-up / -Z forward and each GLB carries its own unit scale. Conversion is per-hull against that hull's measured box and is NOT done here.
acceptance: every hardpoint finite; at least 80% of NAMED left/right pairs mirrored to 5 cm. A hull with no named pair FAILS - a check that could not have failed is not a check.
